summary: Copy a slice onto the same array with overlap-safe direction while preserving holes.

target.notes: Coerce/clamp indices, handle overlap like memmove, copy present properties, delete destination properties when the corresponding source is a hole, and return the receiver.

caveats: Array.Copy alone is insufficient for sparse arrays because a source hole must delete the destination property.

tests.name: source hole deletes destination
tests.input: const a=[1,,3]; a.copyWithin(0,1,2); console.log(a[0],0 in a,a.length);
